patterns.note: Product display sections consistently use a four-column grid for static product previews and a horizontal carousel for featured collections.
A single sans-serif typeface is used across all text elements, with variations in weight and size to establish a clear, understated typographic hierarchy.
The primary palette consists of muted, earthy tones and natural greys, creating a calm and organic visual identity, contrasted by a deep charcoal footer.
The primary navigation bar dynamically reduces in height and gains a subtle background and shadow upon scrolling down, transitioning from transparent to opaque.
The "BEST SELLERS" section features a horizontal product carousel, allowing users to swipe through items without vertical page scroll.
Feature sections are structured with large, full-bleed lifestyle images positioned above concise, three-column text blocks that elaborate on brand values.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that visually transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and adopting a solid background and subtle shadow to maintain prominence while conserving screen space.

The hero section employs a large, immersive background image that appears to be fixed or subtly parallaxed, allowing overlay text to scroll over it, creating a sense of depth and focus on the messaging.
Product collections are presented using a horizontal carousel, likely powered by a library like Swiper, enabling users to browse through multiple items with swipe gestures.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced sans-serif type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, maintaining readability without being overly dominant, using consistent weight for both roles.

standout: The site stands out with its use of a very natural, muted color palette that directly reflects its brand identity of sustainable, natural materials. The integration of large, lifestyle imagery with subtle parallax in the hero section creates an immersive and calming introduction, effectively communicating comfort and connection to nature without being overly flashy.
